name: Edwards 2-Component Surrogate (dodecane / tetralin)
intended_scope: Gas-phase chemical kinetic modeling & shock-tube ignition delay matching (AIAA 2001)
failure_mechanism_reason: Freezing point fails drastically (-29.8 °C vs <= -40.0 °C ASTM D1655) because omitting branched iso-alkanes allows linear n-dodecane to crystallize at elevated temperature. Viscosity at -20 °C (6.89 cSt) exceeds the 6.0 cSt operational guideline. Aromatics (25.5 wt%) exceed the 25.0 wt% ASTM maximum. Distillation T10 (224.8 °C) violates early volatility pumpability limits.

name: Bruno-Huber POSF-10325 3-Component Jet A Surrogate
intended_scope: Advanced Distillation Curve (ADC) and high-temperature oxidation surrogate (Energy & Fuels 2010)
failure_mechanism_reason: Severe cold-flow failure: freezing point is -24.8 °C (spec <= -40.0 °C) due to eutectic crystallization of n-tetradecane (38 wt%) and n-dodecane (31 wt%) without cold-flow depressants. Aromatics (31.0 wt%) grossly exceed the 25.0 wt% ASTM D1655 upper limit, threatening elastomer swell and excessive soot formation.

name: Princeton / Dooley 2nd Generation 4-Component Jet A Surrogate
intended_scope: 4-component combustion kinetic mechanism for flame speed and radical pool matching (Combust. Flame 2012)
failure_mechanism_reason: Catastrophic flash point failure (-1.05 °C vs >= 38.0 °C ASTM D56/D93 safety threshold) caused by adding 22.8 wt% volatile toluene to match H/C and gas-phase phenyl chemistry. Liquid density is too low (765.5 kg/m³ vs 775.0 kg/m³ minimum). Aromatics (30.1 wt%) exceed the 25.0 wt% limit, and distillation onset is too low.

name: NIST RP-1 14-Component Surrogate
intended_scope: NIST thermodynamic property and equation-of-state surrogate for RP-1 rocket kerosene (NISTIR 6646)
failure_mechanism_reason: Formulated for rocket kerosene rather than aviation turbine fuel: high decalin (35 wt%) and cyclic content elevate the recalibrated kinematic viscosity at -20 °C to 7.29 cSt, violating the strict conformal cold-viscosity ceiling required for airframe restart pumpability.

name: IDEAL 4-Component Diesel Surrogate
intended_scope: Automotive diesel combustion & spray ignition delay surrogate (SAE 2007-01-0009)
failure_mechanism_reason: Cold-flow failure: Cloud point / wax appearance temperature (WAT) is +2.9 °C, failing the ASTM D975 spec (<= 0.0 °C). Straight-chain n-hexadecane (35 wt%) precipitates wax crystals at cool ambient temperatures, plugging fuel filters in sub-zero operational service.

name: Sandia / Mueller 4-Component Diesel Surrogate
intended_scope: Optical engine and shock-tube diesel surrogate for DCN and soot propensity matching (Energy & Fuels 2012)
failure_mechanism_reason: Cold-flow failure: Cloud point / WAT is +2.4 °C (violating the <= 0.0 °C ASTM D975 limit) due to high n-hexadecane content (34 wt%). While DCN (48.0) and cetane kinetics are matched, the absence of low-melting naphthenic isomers causes fuel starvation under cold-weather diesel conditions.

name: PSA Peugeot Citroen 4-Component Diesel Surrogate
intended_scope: Euro-diesel multi-component combustion surrogate for engine CFD simulations (Fuel 2010)
failure_mechanism_reason: Multiple physical spec failures: Density is too low (804.8 kg/m³ vs >= 820.0 kg/m³ min); Flash point (55.36 °C) violates conformal safety margin; Cloud point (+0.45 °C) exceeds 0.0 °C; 40 °C viscosity (1.72 cSt) is too thin (ASTM min 1.9 cSt); completely lacks aromatics (0.0 wt%), causing fuel injector pump seal shrinkage and failure.

name: Toluene Reference Fuel TRF-70
intended_scope: Standard ASTM CFR knock engine calibration reference fuel (RON 72.8, MON 69.0)
failure_mechanism_reason: Vapor pressure is severely deficient (DVPE 3.67 kPa vs 45.0 - 105.0 kPa ASTM D4814) due to complete absence of volatile C4/C5 front-ends (butane/pentanes), preventing cold-engine starting. Octane sensitivity (3.77) and distillation curve are non-representative of commercial pump gasoline.

name: Toluene Reference Fuel TRF-80
intended_scope: Standard ASTM CFR knock engine calibration reference fuel (RON 83.3, MON 79.6)
failure_mechanism_reason: Vapor pressure fails (DVPE 3.21 kPa vs 45.0 - 105.0 kPa min) preventing carburetion/port vaporization. Distillation profile is artificially flat across three pure compounds rather than a continuous ASTM D86 curve; octane sensitivity (3.75) is inadequate for modern high-compression spark-ignition engines.

name: Toluene Reference Fuel TRF-90
intended_scope: Standard ASTM CFR knock engine calibration reference fuel (RON 93.9, MON 90.2)
failure_mechanism_reason: Vapor pressure fails (DVPE 2.73 kPa vs 45.0 - 105.0 kPa min); boiling range is restricted to a narrow 90-115 °C band lacking both front-end cold-start volatility and heavy lubricating tail ends.

name: Co-Optima Core 4-Component Gasoline Surrogate
intended_scope: DOE Co-Optima core combustion surrogate for boosted spark-ignition research (SAE 2017-01-0797)
failure_mechanism_reason: Vapor pressure remains below minimum commercial specification (DVPE 27.83 kPa vs 45.0 kPa ASTM D4814 lower limit). T50 distillation (74.03 °C) is too low (violating the 77.0 °C floor), creating susceptibility to vapor lock in hot fuel rails. High octane sensitivity (5.42) lacks balancing components.

name: Phase E Designed Jet A (4-comp)
intended_scope: UGRP Phase E inverse-designed Drop-In Sustainable Aviation Fuel (Jet A)
failure_mechanism_reason: None. Fully compliant with ASTM D1655 across all physical, cryogenic, and safety metrics.

failure_mechanism_reason: None. Fully compliant with ASTM D975 across all physical, cold-flow, and combustion metrics.
